title: Aoyagi Toya — Taking On A New Challenge〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Shrine Grounds

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It doesn't seem all that crowded today.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, things are a lot calmer now.
The line came all the way out to here when we visited the other day.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Sorry for making you guys come here again.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I was with Kohane at PXL during New Year's Day, and didn't get a chance to visit a shrine after that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Actually, I've been hoping that the four of us would be able to do a visit together.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I don't have a problem with pumping ourselves up for the new year like this.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, so let's go say our goals, and make this year a good one.
Several dozen minutes later

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That ended up being a really smooth visit.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! Now that we're done, let's go draw some fortunes.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: In that case, the shrine office is just over there. We've already drawn ours, so you two go on ahead.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay!
Let's go see how lucky we are, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm a little nervous. I hope we get something good.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. We gotta start this year off on the right foot by drawing two great blessings!
se_walk_women_001_1
se_walk_women_001_2

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, they also carry lucky charms here.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Academics, family safety, greater luck, warding off bad luck...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? What's up?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ah, it's just...
se_walk_women_001_2
se_walk_women_001_3

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We've got our fortunes.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hm? What's going on, Toya? Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Not wrong, but... I was just thinking about the charms.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: These charms?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I have to prepare myself mentally, you see.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's obvious in retrospect, but in order to get to the United States, we'll have to fly in an airplane.

rows.Speaker: Akito, Kohane & An
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Statistically, there's no safer mode of transport... But fear appears to be overpowering any sort of logic...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A-Aoyagi, you don't look so good...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: W-well, it's normal to feel scared, since it's gonna take us up so high in the sky.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I know. What if we got some seats with no windows adjacent? That should help, right? And in the event you are assigned a window seat, I'll swap with you, Aoyagi!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Honestly, I wouldn't worry.
Remember what our fortunes said? They didn't say things would go wrong on our trip.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, that's right...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: See?! You'll be fine!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Anyway... Let's see what our fortunes have to say!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: O-Okay. I hope we don't get anything bad.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What?! T-Terrible luck...?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No way! You too, Kohane...?! That's also what I got...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You've gotta be kidding me...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
What are the odds of us both getting these...?
That means we're starting this year off in the worst way imaginable!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
*Sob*
It even says “avoid if possible” in the Trip section...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? What does mine say...? Ugh, it just says “wait”!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Frankly, that's almost impressively bad.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Still, they're just pieces of paper, so I really don't think you need to take them...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We should get ourselves some protective charms.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I might get one for warding off bad luck...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, I'm thinking about getting one to boost my luck...
se_walk_women_001_4

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Y-You guys are taking this way too seriously...
